title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Matthew 16: a demand for a sign, the yeast of the Pharisees, Peter's answer about the Christ, and the cost of following.

questions.text: Who came to test him and asked him to show them a sign from heaven?
questions.explanation: The Pharisees and Sadducees came and, testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

answers.text: The chief priests and the Levites

questions.text: Which sign did he say would be given to an evil and adulterous generation?
questions.explanation: He said an evil and adulterous generation seeks a sign, and no sign would be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

answers.text: The sign of the prophet Isaiah
The sign of the prophet Jonah
The sign of Moses in the wilderness
The sign of the red evening sky

questions.text: What did Jesus tell the disciples to beware of after they had forgotten to take bread?
questions.explanation: Jesus told them to take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

answers.text: The yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees

questions.text: What did the disciples finally understand the yeast stood for?
questions.explanation: They understood that he was not telling them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

answers.text: The teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees

questions.text: According to the disciples, who did men say the Son of Man was?
questions.explanation: They answered that some said John the Baptizer, some Elijah, and others Jeremiah or one of the prophets.

answers.text: John the Baptizer, Elijah, or Jeremiah

questions.text: How did Simon Peter answer when Jesus asked who they said he was?
questions.explanation: Simon Peter answered that he was the Christ, the Son of the living God.

answers.text: The Christ, the Son of the living God
The son of David, the king of Israel
The teacher sent to the lost sheep

questions.text: What did Jesus say he would build on this rock?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that on this rock he would build his assembly, and that the gates of Hades would not prevail against it.

answers.text: A city set on a hill
The temple of God in Jerusalem
A throne for the house of David

questions.text: What did Jesus say he would give to him?
questions.explanation: Jesus said he would give him the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and that what he bound or released on earth would have been bound or released in heaven.

answers.text: The keys of the Kingdom of Heaven

questions.text: What did Jesus say to Peter when Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him?
questions.explanation: Jesus turned and told Peter to get behind him, calling him Satan and a stumbling block, because he was setting his mind on the things of men and not of God.

questions.text: What did Jesus say the Son of Man will do when he comes in the glory of his Father with his angels?
questions.explanation: He said that the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.

answers.text: Gather the nations to the temple
Render to everyone according to his deeds
Build a new city on the mountain
